body: Precise image edit: repaint ONLY the fabric rendering of this existing isolated SIDE VIEW Chinese robe sprite, preserving exact silhouette, placement, canvas aspect and every anchor, neck, waist sash, closed hem, cloud motif locations. This is a small in-game 2D ink-painted character asset. Replace polished pale airbrush and evenly faded sticker patterns with matte traditional ink/gouache: broad decisive ivory light planes, restrained medium grey-blue irregular brush shadows, darker blue-grey sash and edges, cloud motifs slightly broken with varying ink density integrated into cloth. Clear readable larger shapes at 150px character height. Modest dry-brush character, NOT distressed scratches or dense paper noise, no glossy satin, no vector-perfect borders, no photoreal textile fibers. Retain same ivory/greyblue palette and same overall garment design. Few broad robe folds only; no added ornament or slit. Do NOT change geometry, pose, sizes or add body parts. Transparent background.
sleeve: Edit this exact isolated sleeve sprite for a small Chinese ink-painted 2D game. Keep the square canvas, shoulder top position, elbow location, cuff corners, wrist and hand size/position and handedness fixed. Upper arm tapers gently from rounded shoulder; crucial correction: elbow must be thicker, NOT an hourglass pinched waist. Fill out the narrow elbow at y550-620 by about 15 percent on both sides, smoothly blending the upper arm and flared forearm. Forearm still opens into a modest trumpet cuff. NO drawn fabric creases or elbow wrinkles. Repaint smooth airbrush fabric into matte ivory and greyblue ink/gouache, broad irregular light and midtone planes, restrained dry brush, muted darker bluegrey clouds with variable ink density, simple slightly uneven cloth edges. Same cloud pattern placement and meander trim identity, less polished and less vector-perfect. NO dense grain, realistic textile fibers, satin highlights, distress or grime. Hand unchanged. Transparent background, no labels, no shadow outside sprite. Clear silhouette and motifs at small game size.
